summary: Evaluation of the existing one-hour VPD pilot checkpoint 15679, not a new training run. The original batch-1 pilot used 9,738 steps (4,985,856 tokens) and 3,638 allocated L40 seconds, including 400 parameter-only warmup updates. It is unconverged; it is neither the published 413 GPU-hour result nor evidence of a matched-compute method win.
panel: The frozen 80-episode panel uses two full 512-token passages (Pile validation rows 1040 and 1041). Autonomous selection starts with every U/V component on, excludes Delta, then runs CI > 0 on its own states for at most 10 updates; all 80 episodes failed to reach a fixed point. Native-fed CI reads the native model's states and is a separate oracle diagnostic. Execution is upstream FP32 CUDA; KL is an FP64 GPU diagnostic without interval certificates. Native and all-on converted execution passed bitwise parity against the original nano wrappers at 16 tokens.
results: Clean / worst-group mean KL: autonomous 4.62427 / 6.17684; native-fed 1.31802 / 3.31461. Evaluation used 61 allocated GPU seconds. The dense U/V, CI and retained native embedding and norm payload is 22,362,275,840 bits at 32 bits per value. This is not the full C32: threshold and iteration structure, architecture constants, wiring and bindings are not encoded in the Artifact grammar. Per-token traces are not charged.
replay: With the recorded checkpoint and the public model and data present, copy this directory to ~/mpd-data/bench/vpd-matched-codex/eval-1h and its sources/* to ~/mpd-data/bench/vpd-matched-codex/. Submit `python run.py convert` on 1 CPU / 16 GiB for 15 minutes, then `python evaluate_guard.py` on 1 L40 / 4 CPU / 24 GiB for 30 minutes with an afterok dependency. The protocol pins every source, config and data hash; conversion freezes the raw and optimizer-free checkpoint hashes. Use a fresh output path when replaying. Raw checkpoints and data are not in this archive.
records: results/ holds conversion and evaluation jobs 15847 and 15849: source and checkpoint hashes, numeric counts, per-episode results and nonconvergence. No fitting, checkpoint update, coefficient sweep or threshold tuning happens during evaluation.
